ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Optional diagnostics companion for RimMT. v0.2 adds current-job idle duration census, bounded WorkGiver burst attribution, Pawn_PathFollower internal-stage timing, ReachProfile capture/Region.Allows timing, pause/resume gap labeling and catastrophic VFE Empire timing. Measurement-only; disable this mod for normal gameplay when diagnostics are not needed.
